security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http: https: ws: wss:; img-src 'self' asset: http: https: data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: http: https:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Self-hosted music, in a native desktop window.
bundle.longDescription: Peridot is a self-hosted and local-first music platform. This desktop shell shares the official Peridot web client and connects to a user-controlled Peridot server.
